name: Web Scraping with Playwright
description: Navigate to a website, extract specific data, process it with Python, and save results. Tests playwright, execute_code, and variable passing between steps.
context_rules: Only scrape public data. Respect robots.txt. Add delays between requests to avoid rate limiting.

steps.name: Navigate to target page
steps.description: Open the website in a headless browser
steps.instruction: Open a Chromium browser and navigate to {{target_url}}. Wait for the page to fully load. Take a screenshot to confirm the page loaded correctly.

steps.name: Extract page content
steps.description: Extract specific elements from the page
steps.instruction: From the current page, extract the page title, all heading elements (h1, h2, h3), and the first 5 paragraph texts. Print them as a structured JSON object with keys: title, headings, paragraphs. Close the browser when done.

steps.name: Process and save scraped data
steps.description: Parse the extracted data and save to a file
steps.instruction: Take the scraped data from the previous step and process it: count the number of headings, calculate the total word count across all paragraphs, and save a summary report as JSON to /tmp/decisions_test/scrape_report.json. Print the summary.

variables.name: output_file
variables.description: Path to save the scrape report
